name: Alterations
shortDescription: Precise re-fitting for garments you already own — hems, waists, shoulders and full re-cuts.
highlights: Hemming, taking-in and letting-out for trousers, skirts and dresses
Shoulder and sleeve re-fitting for jackets and blazers
Wedding and occasion-wear resizing with rush options
body: Bought off the rack but it doesn't quite sit right? Our alterations bench handles the fine adjustments that turn a good-enough garment into one that fits like it was made for you.
Every piece is pinned and fitted on you first — never guessed from measurements alone — so the final result reflects how the garment actually falls on your body.
We work on suits, dresses, trousers, skirts, coats and formalwear from any retailer, including delicate fabrics like silk, lace and structured tailoring.

seo.title: Garment Alterations
seo.description: Expert alterations for suits, dresses and everyday wear at Lipek Fashion. Hems, resizing and repairs fitted on you, not guessed.
